statement: Among support agents, 27 of 40 (68%) used saved filters weekly after the redesign, up from 9 of 40 before it.
would_be_wrong_if: Weekly saved-filter use falls back toward the pre-redesign level within two months.
limitations: Same 40 agents measured twice; novelty effect not ruled out. e3 shows lower use on night shifts; the claim does not cover them.

evidence.summary: Product analytics on saved-filter use, four weeks before and after.
Diary study on how agents chose filters during the same period.
Night-shift agents barely used saved filters.
